notes.title: Announcement and Patch Note November 28, 2023
notes.notes:
Hello Wandmakers!

New updates have just rolled out from the workshop. The update includes updated visuals, some optimizations, and more fixes. Details are listed below.

[h2]Content Update[/h2]
[list][*]Updated character sprites
[*]Added a character position tracker in the dungeon by pressing the F3 button, so you can report bugs more accurately to us
[*]Added damage numbers to Pucelle when hit by enemies
[*]Added an 'X' sign if you fail a quest[/list]
[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[list][*]Changed the button prompt position when interacting with Watcher (Q/Exit on the left, E/Talk on the right)
[*]Changed the position of 'Required Material' from left to right in the Crafting screen
[*]Updated highlighted words in the dialogue box with a larger font
[*]Reapplied occlusion culling to the 2D environment assets[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Fixed bushes LOD
[*] Fixed loading screen
[*] Fixed overlapping quest text
[*] Fixed wrong button prompts in some UI screens
[*] Fixed the store collider. No more passing through the wall now
[*] Fixed the collider of stone rubbles and pink mushroom disks in the dungeon
[*] Fixed character movement/animation when standing on the edge of a platform
[*] Fixed the issue that makes the cursor disappear when moving from one tab to another in the menu[/list]
[h2]The Mushrooms Desperately Need a Break...[/h2]
We also want to inform you that after a year of developing non-stop, [u][b]Mushroomallow will take a break this December and will continue development again in January 2024[/b][/u]. We will still reply and take note of all bug reports and suggestions we receive, but we'll address them in January.

[h2]For Playtesters[/h2]
[u][b]We decided to deactivate the playtest build on December 10 at 11 pm WIB (UTC+7)[/b][/u]. But once again, if you miss it, you can still play Wonder Wandelier from the demo build, which will be available at all times. Our Discord server is also available at all times if you want to send your feedback.
___________________________________________________________________

We hope you enjoy this latest update! Once again, we'd like to thank each one of you for playing Wonder Wandelier and for sending us your feedback and suggestions. It would also mean the world to us if you could share the game or recommend it to a friend who might enjoy it.

Wishing you all a wonderful time this holiday season! Have fun crafting and selling magic wands in Wonder Wandelier!
